en.title: Snowflake numbering press
en.label: A numbering press with one wheel per usable bit, sliding timestamp, worker and sequence fences, mechanical bit counters and a clock that stalls during rollback.
en.aria: Select a bank with left and right arrows, Home or End. Up and down change its bit budget; timestamp bits borrow from the sequence bank. Space or Enter replays the burst; Escape stops. Point at the wheels to preview a bank and click to select it.
en.caption: Each printing wheel is one usable bit; the sliding fences divide timestamp, worker and sequence banks. Increasing worker or sequence bits shortens timestamp lifetime. The bright rider consumes a burst on one worker, stops when the sequence is full, and the clock stalls during rollback. The demonstration is slowed, not a throughput benchmark.
en.description: {bank}: timestamp {time} bits, worker {worker} bits, sequence {sequence} bits. Theoretical capacity {capacity} IDs per second; burst plus rollback wait {wait} milliseconds.
en.phase.ready: Ready: the banks show the current bit budget.
en.phase.rollback: Clock rollback: issuance stalls until time catches up.
en.phase.sequence: The burst consumes sequence slots on one worker.
en.phase.overflow: Sequence exhausted: wait for the next millisecond window.
en.phase.invalid: Worker identities are insufficient: reject the configuration rather than reuse an identity.
en.phase.stamp: The safe timestamp and sequence permit the burst to be stamped.

id.title: Mesin penomor Snowflake
id.label: Mesin penomor dengan satu roda untuk tiap bit yang bisa dipakai, pembatas geser bank timestamp, worker, dan sequence, penghitung bit mekanis, serta jam yang berhenti saat waktu mundur.
id.aria: Pilih bank dengan panah kiri dan kanan, Home atau End. Panah atas dan bawah mengubah anggaran bitnya; bit timestamp diambil dari bank sequence. Spasi atau Enter memutar ulang burst; Escape menghentikannya. Arahkan penunjuk ke roda untuk melihat bank, lalu klik untuk memilih.
id.caption: Setiap roda pencetak mewakili satu bit yang bisa dipakai; pembatas geser membagi bank timestamp, worker, dan sequence. Menambah bit worker atau sequence memperpendek umur epoch. Penunjuk terang melacak pemakaian slot sequence oleh burst pada satu worker dan berhenti saat slot penuh; jam berhenti saat waktu mundur. Demonstrasi diperlambat, bukan benchmark throughput.
id.description: {bank}: timestamp {time} bit, worker {worker} bit, sequence {sequence} bit. Kapasitas teoritis {capacity} ID/s; waktu tunggu burst dan clock rollback {wait} ms.
id.phase.ready: Siap: bank menunjukkan anggaran bit saat ini.
id.phase.rollback: Jam mundur: penerbitan berhenti hingga waktu menyusul.
id.phase.sequence: Burst memakai slot sequence pada satu worker.
id.phase.overflow: Sequence habis: tunggu jendela milidetik berikutnya.
id.phase.invalid: Identitas worker tidak mencukupi: tolak konfigurasi, jangan gunakan ulang identitas.
id.phase.stamp: Timestamp dan sequence yang aman memungkinkan burst diberi nomor.
